about_the_game:
Sweet Start is not just a taste of what's to come - it’s a standalone experience that lets you explore the mechanics and atmosphere of building your candy empire


In the free Sweet Start you can expect:
🔸 Your First Candy Shop
🔸 Craft Basic Candy Recipes
🔸 Stock and Organize Shelves
🔸 Serve Customers
🔸 Customize Your Shop
🔸 Unlock Starter Upgrades
🔸 Prepare for Expansion

Please remember that this is just the beginning of an amazing adventure that awaits you in Candy Shop Simulator!

BEGIN YOUR SWEET ADVENTURE!

Candy Shop Simulator: Sweet Start is your first step into the world of confectionery entrepreneurship. Open your small shop and get to know the basics of managing your business, crafting delightful treats, and serving customers. It’s the ideal starting point for your journey toward becoming a candy tycoon!

CREATE UNIQUE PASTRIES

Sweet Start gives you the chance to experiment with basic recipes for sweets in the full version of Candy Shop Simulator you will get a massive range ons sweets. Unleash your creativity and craft delightful pastries that will charm your customers. This is a great way to familiarize yourself with the production process, which will be even more advanced in the full version of the game.

SELL YOUR CREATIONS

Open your shop doors in Sweet Start and watch as your sugary creations attract your first customers. Learn how to manage sales and build relationships with patrons - skills that will be essential in the full version of Candy Shop Simulator.

PREPARE FOR MORE!

Candy Shop Simulator: Sweet Start is just the beginning of your adventure. The full version of the game offers so much more—from new recipes and shop expansions to advanced marketing strategies and team management. Sweet Start gives you a taste of what’s waiting for you in the future!


Candy Shop Simulator: Sweet Start is the perfect option for those who want to test their skills and explore the world of Candy Shop Simulator before committing to the full version. It’s not just a prologue - it’s a standalone experience that prepares you for even greater challenges ahead!

  • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 780
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recommend installation on an SSD drive
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recommend installation on an SSD drive
